worldcombat.skill.bulletseed.summary: Fires seeds as independent shots on a steady beat: the previous seed is still in the air as the next leaves the muzzle, each colliding once and settling on whatever it actually hits first. Where you aim in that beat is where that seed flies, and once the original target falls the remaining seeds keep sweeping. Heavy seeds are few and dense; rapid seeds are many and spread.
worldcombat.skill.bulletseed.use.0: Pin down a movement lane with a line of real seed deliveries at close-mid range
worldcombat.skill.bulletseed.use.1: Pile damage on a low-defence target through sheer shot count
worldcombat.skill.bulletseed.use.2: Fast wind-up and repeating shots for constant pressure up close
worldcombat.skill.bulletseed.description: Each seed deals %1$s physical damage to whatever it actually hits first, settled per seed; the burst fires %2$s seeds (2-5 natively, set by the user's data). Each shot reads the current aim and can sweep to a new direction mid-burst; if the target falls or leaves, the remaining seeds still fly on the same beat rather than homing onto someone else.
A seed leaves every %1$s, flies at %2$s blocks/tick, reaches %3$s blocks and scatters by up to ±%4$s; several seeds can be in the air at once.
Each seed has a %1$s block hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.bulletseed.heavy.on: Heavy seeds: per-seed power x1.35, larger seeds and spread x0.6; costs a burst capped at 3, seed speed x0.9, wind-up +2 ticks, cooldown +4 ticks and interval +1 tick.
worldcombat.skill.bulletseed.heavy.off: Rapid fire: up to 5 seeds, interval -1 tick and seed speed x1.12; costs per-seed power x0.82 and spread x1.35.
worldcombat.skill.bulletseed.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bulletseed.growth.0: From level %1$s the per-seed power rises to %2$s and the burst grows to %3$s seeds.
worldcombat.skill.bulletseed.growth.1: From level %1$s the per-seed power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
On: per-seed power x1.35, larger seeds and a tighter spread for a single thick target; costs a burst capped at 3, seed speed x0.9, wind-up +2 ticks, cooldown +4 ticks and interval +1 tick. Off (rapid fire): up to 5 seeds, a tighter interval and seed speed x1.12, at the cost of per-seed power x0.82 and a wider spread.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: low-health targets rank higher so a burst finishes them; off: all targets score the same.
